Pappu Yadav Attends Parliament with Bandages and Crutches

Lok Sabha MP Pappu Yadav attended Parliament with a bandage on his forehead, a plaster on his hand, and a crutch on his shoulder. He stated that he was protesting an insult to the 'pag' (a traditional headgear) and expressed anger. The incident occurred during a parliamentary session.
